title: ID Ban
description: A mod that bans items, blocks, and entities to spice up survival in various ways.
body:
## ID Ban
This mod allows you to ban ID's (items, blocks, entities) from being interacted with in the world. This mod was created for those who like gimmicky challenges. Want to try beating the game but you can't touch grass blocks, go ahead!
### Features
* **Item Ban:** Automatically clears restricted items from player inventories.
* **Block Ban:** Kills players who physically collide with banned blocks.
* **Entity Ban:** Prevents damage to and interaction with banned entities.
* **Metadata Support:** Supports banning specific block variants (e.g., `/blacklist block minecraft:planks 1` for Spruce only).

### Commands
* `/blacklist <item|block|entity> <id> [metadata]`
* `/unlist <item|block|entity> <id> [metadata]`
